content.short: Moox Protocol is an all-in-one DeFi platform with staking and lottery utilities.
content.description: Moox Protocol is a newer financial protocol that makes staking easier and more efficient, while awarding MOOX token holders the highest stable returns in crypto. Its benefits include earning a lottery ticket for every 25 BUSD worth of purchases, earning MOOX for staking liquidity pool (LP) tokens, and earning a lottery ticket for staking MOOX itself. The protocol charges a 1% buy/sell fee and supports tax-free liquidity adding and removing, simplifying on-chain liquidity management for users.
content.meta: Moox Protocol is a protocol that simplifies staking and helps MOOX holders earn returns. Discover Moox Protocol and other DeFi Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
